user.title: Observe your heating
user.description: Select the room thermostats to observe. This version only reads data; existing heating controls continue to operate.

room.title: Configure {room}
room.description: Optionally select an independent air sensor and a zone demand sensor. Otherwise the thermostat attributes are used. This does not change the sensor used by your thermostat.

system.title: System observations
system.description: All inputs are optional. Select measured flow/return temperatures. For DHW, use a resolved signal such as Boiler Flow Control DHW Active. Unknown activity remains unknown.

error.invalid_source: Choose a valid source outside this integration.

abort.already_configured: Only one heating system can be configured.
